notes: Four side-by-side T blocks stacked left to right. The header of block 2 prints 289.15 K but Table 3, Table 6 and Figure 8 give 289.45 K and its 12.43 MPa row equals the 289.45 K hydrate formation pressure; so 289.15 is probably a misprint of 289.45 (printed value kept). Rows before the hydrate formation pressure are gas-liquid (no hydrate); the row at the formation pressure is taken as hydrate-onset. Dissolved gas composition not reported (total gas); no gas_basis applicable. The printed unit label 'mol %' with factor 10^3 is judged a mislabel on physical grounds (value x 1e-3 is a mole fraction of the right magnitude for CH4 in water at 293 K, 6-21 MPa; the same label appears in the authors' Figure 7/8 and Table 6); the number is used as a mole fraction x 1e-3, not corrected by a factor 100. Block 2 label is printed 289.15 K; set to 289.45 K because Table 3 (p.2349) lists 289.45 K with p(exp) 12.43 MPa (the block's hydrate-onset row), and Table 6 and the Figure 8/9 legends print 289.45 K; printed 289.15 K judged a misprint.
